asset.name: Your visitor has arrived
asset.description: Sent to the host when their visitor signs in.
asset.subject: Your visitor {{form.visitor_name}} has arrived
asset.html_body:
{{form.visitor_name}} is at reception

Hi {{host_name}},

{{form.visitor_name}}{{=IF(form.company, CONCAT(" from ", form.company), "")}} signed in at {{=FORMAT_DATE(NOW(), "HH:mm")}} for: {{form.purpose}}.

Badge {{badge}} · visit {{visit_ref}}
